label: Specialty drug — novel mechanism of action
source: Public sales-history analogs: pembrolizumab (Keytruda) NSCLC 1L, dupilumab (Dupixent) AD — first 5yr ramp normalized to eligible population
note: New MoA drugs with no direct competitor at launch; assumes Breakthrough/Priority Review designation

label: Me-too / crowded class
source: IQVIA analog methodology — 4th+ entrant in crowded class (e.g. JAK inhibitors in RA)
note: Highly competitive; requires strong differentiation or price discount

label: Orphan / rare disease drug
source: Public orphan drug launches: nusinersen (Spinraza), risdiplam (Evrysdi), voretigene (Luxturna)
note: Small designated population, high unmet need; faster uptake but smaller absolute market

label: Hospital enterprise clinical software
source: EHR/clinical AI adoption literature: Epic rollout timelines, Viz.ai CSC penetration 2019-2023
note: Slow procurement / IT integration; peak ~30% of addressable sites is aggressive; budget cycle 18-24mo

label: Interventional single-use device
source: Boston Scientific / Medtronic public disclosure for structural heart devices
note: Penetration vs total eligible procedures; assumes FDA PMA/510k + training pathway

label: Companion diagnostic / molecular test
source: Guardant Health FY2023 10-K: $416M US oncology revenue vs ~$1.5B addressable SAM (2M cancer Dx × 30% advanced × $2,500 net) implies 28% y3 penetration. Peak calibrated to ~47% (dominant-player ceiling in multi-competitor liquid biopsy market, lower than pure companion Dx tied to single therapeutic).
note: Multi-analyte liquid biopsy competes with Foundation Medicine, local labs; lower penetration ceiling than a tied companion Dx. Validation (FY2023): engine $420M vs actual $416M (1% APE after correction from 44%).

label: Novel antibiotic / antimicrobial
source: Omadacycline (Nuzyra), ceftazidime-avibactam (Avycaz) commercial ramps — antimicrobials notoriously slow uptake; stewardship programs gatekeep prescribing
note: ID formulary gatekeeping + stewardship delays = slow ramp even for last-resort agents
